seed: Say hi! Tell each other your name and where you're from.
What's been living rent-free in your head lately?
What are you studying or working on, and be honest: is it a W or are you just surviving?
What does your For You page say about you right now?
You're on aux for a 3-hour road trip. First song, no skips. Go.
Drop your most unhinged {interest} take. The other person has to rate it: valid or cooked?
Name a harmless habit that's an instant red flag to you.
What's the most NPC thing you've done this week?
Which trend needs to be cancelled immediately? Defend your answer.
What gives you the ick instantly? Be specific.
Last 3am internet rabbit hole you fell down about {interest}?
What show, game or album is your emotional support media?
Something everyone hypes that's actually mid. Go. Other person has to agree or fight you.
Pick a side, no fence-sitting: {interest} edition. Invent the matchup and defend your pick.
Tell the story of your most main-character moment. Or your most embarrassing one.
What role do you play in your group chat? The planner, the lurker, the chaos agent, the meme supplier?
What's something you'll happily overspend on that other people think is a waste?
What's a rule your parents had that you'll keep, and one you'll definitely break?
Hot take on modern dating: talking stage, situationships, or apps. Which one is the most cooked?
What's an opinion you have that would get you ratioed online?
What's something you were dead wrong about a few years ago?
What's something you pretend not to care about, but actually do?
What would 13-year-old you think of you now: proud, confused, or disappointed?
Is it harder to make friends now than when you were a kid? Why do you think so?
Why does {interest} actually matter to you? The real reason, not the LinkedIn one.
Best advice you ignored, and was ignoring it the right call?
You just spawned here. First move?
Rate this out of 10. Be brutal.
Caption this like it's going viral. Best caption wins.
Which one of you ends up here, and is it a W or an L?
What does this remind you of? Your pics or it didn't happen.
Plan a day here together. You each veto one thing.
What would it take for your real life to feel more like this?
Five years from now, are you here? Why or why not?
